classroom.title: Classroom
classroom.intro: Answer 5 questions on the board. There is no timer, so take your time.
classroom.result.title: Your result
quiz.classroom.budget.needs_first.q: Sana gets ₹4,000 this month. What should she pay for first?
quiz.classroom.budget.needs_first.why: Needs come first. The bus pass gets her to tuition, so her income keeps coming.
quiz.classroom.budget.opportunity_cost.q: Ravi spends ₹600 on a cricket bat. What else does that choice cost him?
quiz.classroom.budget.opportunity_cost.w: Money spent on one thing can't go to another. This is called opportunity cost.
quiz.classroom.save.emergency_fund.q: Your phone screen cracks. Which jar should pay for the repair?
quiz.classroom.save.emergency_fund.why: An emergency fund is money kept aside for surprise costs, so you don't need to borrow.
quiz.classroom.save.track_spending.q: Sana's money runs out before the month ends. What is a good first step?
quiz.classroom.save.track_spending.o1: Write down every spend for a week
quiz.classroom.save.track_spending.why: Tracking shows where the money goes. Then you can choose what to cut.
quiz.classroom.invest.risk_return.q: In the game, Rocket Co can grow fast but can also fall a lot. What does this show?
quiz.classroom.invest.risk_return.o3: Risk and growth are not linked
quiz.classroom.invest.risk_return.why: Things that might grow more can also drop more. This is risk and return.
quiz.classroom.invest.diversify.q: Why might someone split money between Steady Deposit and Mixed Basket?
quiz.classroom.invest.diversify.o1: So one bad year hurts less
quiz.classroom.invest.diversify.why: Spreading money out means one bad result doesn't hit all of it. This is called diversification.
quiz.classroom.safe.otp.q: A caller says they are from your bank and asks for your OTP. What do you do?
quiz.classroom.safe.otp.why: Real bank staff never ask for your OTP. Report fraud calls to the 1930 helpline.
quiz.classroom.safe.collect_request.q: A UPI request says 'receive ₹500' and asks for your PIN. What is true?
quiz.classroom.safe.collect_request.o2: You need a PIN to receive
quiz.classroom.safe.collect_request.why: You never need a PIN to receive money. A PIN only sends money from your account.
